boss_training.name: Boss Training
boss_training.blurb: A world boss fought for score — deal as much damage as you can before you fall or the timer expires. Higher damage means higher placement.

current.summary: Abyssal Slime both deals and is weak to Mental damage — so Mental-damage witches score highest here.

mechanics.name: Wake-up Kickback
mechanics.text: When he comes out of knockdown, he unleashes a huge kickback that hits for very high damage.
mechanics.counter: Stun him just as the knockdown is ending and the kickback is skipped entirely. Carmen's Extreme lands the timing perfectly.

comps.name: Mental burst + timed stun
comps.note: Stack Mental-damage dealers to exploit the weakness, with a reliable stunner (Carmen) to cancel the wake-up kick. Add your best Mental DPS here — tell me who and I'll fill the slots.

tower.name: Tower of Anomalies
tower.blurb: A static 50-floor climb of rising difficulty. Most floors are routine, but a handful gate hard on specific bosses. This section flags those walls and how to beat them.
